desc: The BROADSWORD-89 series are built on SOLGW BROADSWORD billet uppers and lowers, and utilize the L89 Drivelock Handguard. Built with an extended Titanium barrel nut, their Precision SPR 416 Stainless barrels, and an extended trigger reach engineered into the lower receiver, these rifle are built for maximum precision. These rifles all feature a A5 Length Buffer System, Liberty Charging Handle, Liberty Two Stage trigger, B5 P23 Grip, B5 Bravo Stocks, an ambi bolt release and an Ambi Selector. The 7-sided L89 handguard features integral steel QD cups on both sides.
